title: Warriors' Super Fan E-40 Drops New Video 'Front Row' Before Game 3 Between Kings & Warriors [Watch]
htmlContent:
E-40, the iconic rapper and avid sports fan, has just released a music video for his latest track titled "Front Row 40." The song pays homage to E-40's frequent presence in the front row at games of the Golden State Warriors, San Francisco 49ers, and San Francisco Giants. The video showcases E-40's passion for sports, featuring footage of him at various games, as well as appearances by notable sports figures such as Klay Thompson, Stephen Curry, and Guy Fieri.

The release of "Front Row 40" comes shortly after E-40's recent ejection from a playoff game between the Warriors and the Sacramento Kings at the Golden 1 Center in Sacramento, California. Initially attributing the incident to racial bias, E-40 and the Kings have since clarified that it was due to a miscommunication. Undeterred, E-40 has announced his plans to attend the Warriors' upcoming game at the Chase Center in San Francisco, demonstrating his unwavering support for his favorite teams.

As a well-known figure in both the music and sports communities, E-40's "Front Row 40" is a testament to his love for the game and his dedication to being a front-row fixture at the games of his beloved Bay Area teams. The music video captures his enthusiasm for sports and showcases his unwavering support for his teams, solidifying his status as a proud and passionate sports fan.
